chapter: Advice to youth and the art of drumming
title: Youth concerts and college band clinics
summary: DeMichael describes a planned youth concert; Saunders cites Governors State, Triton and Notre Dame clinics.

blocks.x: You know, there are so many fine young musicians.

This is the thing, yeah, this is what you were saying. Fine musicians, and they're coming right out of -- they're getting their educations within these colleges and through a lot of these bands, because they get good instructors.
Yeah. Well, like, Billy Howell is teaching at Governors State.

You know, the Jazz Institute wants to do a youth concert Memorial Day weekend, if we can find a place to do it. But not the usual youth concert, where young people come to hear something, the other way around.
And the older people come in to see it, right.
Youth, the young talent, right. Well, you've got it, it's out here, you know?
That Governors State band is a killer.

Right, and, see, these -- you know, they get these band clinics in different places, like Triton College and all the different colleges they have, Notre Dame and all of that. You hear some fantastic music.
